name: frontend-e2e
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project frontend-e2e --web

e2e.// dependsOn: CI starts api:serve and frontend:serve-e2e itself, outside of any nx process, before this target runs (see .github/workflows/ci.yml). Clearing this stops @nx/playwright/plugin from also scheduling api:serve as a task here, which would otherwise race the CI-started one for port 3000.

test-stack-up.//: Keeps the full-stack lane off the dev stack. CI uses service containers instead.

commands: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d --wait redis mailpit
cd libs/shared/prisma && npx prisma migrate deploy

test-stack-down.//: Wipes the test database. globalTeardown already does this after a run; this is for a manual reset.

e2e-local.//: Local full-stack run. The docker and prisma steps are inlined rather than calling `nx run test-stack-up`, to avoid a nested Nx CLI invocation.

commands: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d --wait redis mailpit
cd libs/shared/prisma && npx prisma migrate deploy
